observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage performance with light background and musicians seated on the right side.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of about 10-12 dancers, men and women.
observation.formation_and_space: Group initially in a line, then breaking into pairs or solo moments while moving across the stage.
observation.posture: Upright, erect torso, knees slightly bent during footwork steps, weight shifting dynamically between feet.
observation.footwork: Lively stepping and rhythmic tapping or stamping patterns on the beat, quick changes of weight.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held high or curved, hands snapping or holding props such as tambourines or hats, raising and waving them.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso mostly upright with expressive bends and turns, subtle hip movement driven by footwork.
observation.partnering: Mostly individual or paired interaction without continuous closed contact hold.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent turns and spins, occasional drops or low lunges with skirt manipulation.
observation.costume_and_props: Women wear long white ruffled dresses with tiered skirts, men wear black trousers, short jackets, white shirts, and black hats.
observation.cannot_infer: Low resolution black and white video makes precise foot articulation and facial expressions difficult to see in detail.

signature_moments.what: Dancers line up across the stage holding arms high and stepping rhythmically.
Dancers hold hats aloft and circle around each other with fast footwork.
Female dancer drops to a low knee level while partner circles around her.
